verdict.rationale: Databricks' core engine processes data in bulk: ANSI SQL with Delta Lake extensions runs over entire tables, batch and streaming computation is supported, and ETL pipelines process whole datasets. The CLI and Python SDK are documented for automating platform operations from scripts, and Unity Catalog objects can be managed through SQL, CLI and REST APIs. However, no evidence shows first-party bulk actions for managing many assets at once (jobs, permissions, catalog objects), so applying an operation to many items appears to require scripting. missing for 10: documented native bulk/batch endpoints or UI actions for operating on many workspace assets at once, AI-agent-driven bulk actions, independent hands-on corroboration.
